dataset.selection_policy: complete EN/DE holdout plus complete committed A4 negatives

runner_provenance.cold_start_metric: external process start to first validated response

comparison_gates.correctness: zero-tolerance integer-count ratchets; ratios are diagnostics only
comparison_gates.performance: clean_ms p95 uses a separately configured tolerance and is informational by default
comparison_gates.population: candidate and baseline evaluated-population provenance and invariant counts must match
comparison_gates.release_readiness: production cell must have zero correctness failures

notes: All labeled PII bytes are included in the primary safety score.
A protected byte counts for safety even when its action is not reversible.
Restore, manifest, pipeline, and telemetry failures remain separate hard failures.
Final protection evidence contains offsets, classes, counts, and stable IDs only; never PII values.
Latency is considered only after correctness gates pass.
